detail.command:
printf '
--- git status ---
'; git status --short; printf '
--- package scripts ---
'; node -e "const p=require('./package.json'); console.log(JSON.stringify(p.scripts,null,2))"; printf '
--- relevant files ---
'; find . -maxdepth 4 -type f \( -name 'App.tsx' -o -name '*Market*' -o -name '*market*' -o -name '*Bitcoin*' -o -name '*bitcoin*' -o -name '*.test.ts' -o -name '*.test.tsx' \) -not -path './node_modules/*' | sort; printf '
--- App.tsx ---
'; sed -n '1,240p' App.tsx; printf '
--- src files ---
'; find src -maxdepth 4 -type f 2>/dev/null | sort | while read f; do echo "===== $f ====="; sed -n '1,260p' "$f"; done; printf '
--- tests ---
'; find __tests__ -maxdepth 3 -type f 2>/dev/null | sort | while read f; do echo "===== $f ====="; sed -n '1,300p' "$f"; done
